transcript: The next time you realize you're not invited, when people make plans and your name isn't even mentioned, let them. When someone enjoys your presence but avoids choosing you fully, let them. When a partner does not walk beside you in the small efforts, or your workplace shifts in ways you never asked for, let them. So much of our suffering comes from trying to manage other people's choices, moods and timing. We exhaust ourselves fighting currents we were never meant to control. Peace begins the moment you loosen your grip and allow people to be exactly who they are. Because when you let them, they reveal themselves, and clarity is a gift. When you finally see who someone truly is, you stop guessing, you stop waiting, you stop begging for signs. And in that moment, you are free to choose what truly aligns with your life. So let them go where they choose, and you go where you are respected, valued and honored. And if you are ready to stop chasing people, stop overthinking and start building a stronger, calmer mind, that is exactly why I wrote my book, The Monk's 30 Day Mind Reset. It is a simple 30 day journey to rebuild discipline, regain inner peace and take back control of your life. If you are ready for that reset, the link is in my profile.
